# KumQuote

> Quotes worth remembering — famous quotes with the meaning behind them, by author and category. English only. New quotes added daily.

## Browse

- [Home](https://kumquote.pages.dev/)
- [All quotes](https://kumquote.pages.dev/quotes/)
- [Authors](https://kumquote.pages.dev/authors/)
- [Categories](https://kumquote.pages.dev/categories/)
- [Tags](https://kumquote.pages.dev/tags/)
- [Collections](https://kumquote.pages.dev/collections/)
- [Random quote](https://kumquote.pages.dev/random/)
- [Search](https://kumquote.pages.dev/search/)
- [About](https://kumquote.pages.dev/about/)
- [Submit a quote](https://kumquote.pages.dev/submit/)
- [Contact](https://kumquote.pages.dev/contact/)
- [Daily quote / newsletter](https://kumquote.pages.dev/newsletter/)

## Feeds and data

- [RSS feed](https://kumquote.pages.dev/rss.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://kumquote.pages.dev/sitemap-index.xml)
- [All quotes as JSON](https://kumquote.pages.dev/quotes-data.json)

## Notes

- Every quote is a real, well-known quote with correct attribution; a source is shown only where it is certain.
- Over 1,000 quotes across 12 categories, growing daily.
- Favorites are stored in the visitor's browser only (localStorage); there is no account system.
- Full details: [llms-full.txt](https://kumquote.pages.dev/llms-full.txt)
